profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Data Pipelines • APIs • AI
profile.summary:
I'm still building data pipelines in Azure, just using my experience and knowledge to support a mission I deeply care about. World Vision is the trusted partner of NGOs, governments, and communities all around the world for development and humanitarian relief work - and the work I do increases their impact. 

On the technical side, I have deep experience designing and operating distributed data pipelines, APIs, and access platforms that handle high-volume, high-sensitivity workloads. My work spans systems processing authentication signals across Microsoft Entra ID as well as platforms managing confidential child and donor information at World Vision. I leverage AI-based analysis and guardrails to improve resilience, identify meaningful signals, and drive better outcomes. Across these environments, I've remained focused on building secure, trustworthy systems through ethical engineering and inclusive decision-making.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Federal Way, Washington, United States · Remote
positions.description: Our team builds the underlying fundraising and child sponsorship infrastructure for World Vision USA. We enable live concert fundraising events, end of year giving, and automated and recurring donations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I own the distributed pipelines and access APIs that deliver authentication and audit data used for threat detection, compliance, and security analytics across Microsoft’s identity ecosystem. My work spans architecture, reliability engineering, secure‑by‑design data handling, and AI‑driven signal improvements at global scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I work on the Intelligent Data Experiences - Reporting and Audit Insights team for Azure Identity and Network Access. We help develop key insights into Entra for our customers by streaming and analyzing security audit logs at scale.
Our services give insights into the actions of a customer's tenant, such as viewing sign ins, understanding MFA flows, finding risk, and viewing audit logs. 
I help design and build scalable and performant solutions to global cloud services and help maintain livesite to keep our customers informed. I work primarily in .NET Core and K8S.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer on the Data Insights and Reporting team in Azure Identity. 
Worked on projects bringing key authentication signals to customer's for them to secure their tenant with MFA and to understand authentication flows. 
Worked on maintaining livesite in an on call capacity to ensure customers received their data within SLA and that the data was secure, reliable, and cost efficient. 
Worked primarily in .NET Core, K8S, Service Fabric, and Typescript.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on a project that was an intersection of biochemistry, computer science, information, and theology. This project involved extensive research into information theory, RNA, the origins of life, and machine learning.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
My responsibilities included:
- bug fixes and minor enhancements for a developing service. 
- primary developer on a new service for Azure Active Directory's Access Panel.
I worked in Office Fabric React, Redux, TypeScript, C#, and MSGraph.
I gained experience working with several PMs involved in my project and how to work in an agile work environment.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Customer Support · Visual Studio · C# · Git · Diversity & Inclusion · Computer Science · Testing

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
My responsibilities included: 
- testing my own and other developers' work.
- fixing bugs and coding minor enhancements.
- customer support coverage through their online support tool.
- core membership in several enhancement projects related to activity log views, calendars, and other full stack projects.
I worked mostly in PHP, Java, JavaScript, and SQL.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · MySQL · Apache · Customer Support · Diversity & Inclusion · Java · Computer Science · Testing

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I worked as a teaching assistant for the statistics class for science majors at SPU.

honors.title: Alpha Kappa Sigma
honors.description:
Undergraduate students who have earned 90 credits at SPU and are in the top 10 percent of their graduating class are eligible for election to the honor society Alpha Kappa Sigma.
This honor society has chapters in all the colleges of SPU’s sponsoring denomination. During their senior year, candidates are recommended by an academic policies committee and elected by vote of the faculty.
honors.issuer: Issued by Seattle Pacific University · Jun 2019

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: A member of the Dean's List for all 12 quarters at SPU.
honors.issuer: Issued by Seattle Pacific University · Jun 2019

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Actively shape the program's future through quarterly advisory board meetings.
- Provide strategic input on curriculum development, mission, and vision statements.
- Offer valuable feedback to the senior class on project designs and final products throughout the academic year.
- Foster meaningful connections with students as a dedicated mentor.
- Bridge the gap between academia and industry by seamlessly integrating real-world insights into the school's programs.
